annotations.title: Move a scheduled post to a new time

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] MOVES A SCHEDULED POST to `scheduledAt` (ISO 8601 with a timezone, e.g. "2026-11-19T15:00:00Z"; more than 5 minutes ahead). The booking keeps its id, caption, media, accounts and options; its posting-queue slot follows. Returns { status: "rescheduled", scheduledAt }. Refused within 5 minutes of the current slot, while it is posting or posted, and in a brand whose scheduled posts require review. Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) and the Pro plan or higher; each publish counts against the plan's direct posts for the month. Confirm the new time (and its timezone) with the user first.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/posts/{id}.)

id.description: The post: `convexPostId` from POST /api/v2/publish, or `posts[].id` from GET /api/v2/content/{id}.

scheduledAt.description: Move the post to this time (ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, e.g. "2026-11-19T15:00:00Z"); more than 5 minutes in the future. Send it on its own: no other field with it.

name: reschedule_post
title: Move a scheduled post to a new time
